summary: Saint Ignatius was a bishop and martyr whose letters urged the faithful to unity and obedience to Christ. His witness remains a powerful teaching on love of the Church.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Ignatius of Antioch as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Ignatius of Antioch, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
